question: In a certain code language, 'EXCESS' is written as '726572121', 'ENERGY' is written as '716720927', how will 'ESCAPE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'EXCESS' is written as '726572121'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e88ffce3a9c82e15e8e7c4ca7efc80736385ed951a7e910135647352bc1cc66.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e9928a3bd5a7f0bd343daa0b90c09ed289f56710351c9096c29b16f16a406e2.png] 

And,

'ENERGY' is written as '716720927'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92ee0cbc73956ee3574059ce63fd4305387a57bd355dc2ef89e44838fbaea88f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed94343bcd28b270950f94d4a3a9fc80b82c9287c160106e7272d682c42137ad.png] 

Similarly,

'ESCAPE' is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b34756c6425f9715e167e6d3bb574334148e0ec90e70f94c14d209db96bf600a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e82a63ef7c89a4d258d9f791e00005a44fb1c0f1309534f9e30ea069f90089e.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
